The Blue #11A page shows 0 sales in any grade, and no #11B exists there. HoodCar has a page titled '2023 BOWMAN U NOW MARCH MADNESS AUTO-BLUE ANGEL REESE ROOKIE RC /49 PSA 10 AUTO' (https://hoodcar.com/card/406748726250) claiming a 'last sold' $841 on Jun 5 (29 bids). Not used: the same $841/Jun 5/29-bid entry also appears on an unrelated HoodCar page (Purple #11 /25 non-auto), so it looks misattributed. That page's current asking price is $220. 130point and eBay sold search were blocked.
